title: Handle unavailable positive review controls before reading `problems`.
comment:
**Handle unavailable positive review controls before reading `problems`.**

If a positive control returns `{ unavailable: ... }`, `r.result.problems.length` throws. The funded run then cannot produce its offline audit of that failure. Treat an unavailable review as a failed control without dereferencing `problems`.
